description: Behavior patches the fork must never lose. Each entry is checked after every upstream sync; tests are the focused proof, markers catch a silently dropped patch.

patches.summary: Resolve provider ids to UI aliases before model-registry lookups.
Reject an Antigravity request whose normalized history has no usable content.
markers: Antigravity request has no usable content after normalization

patches.summary: 200k context and High default thinking for Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6, with a 64k envelope fallback.
Cap Antigravity 502 retries at one and use a 30s connect timeout.
Treat a 429 from the Cloud Code probe as a valid token (quota-exhausted, not revoked).
markers: Treat as valid so login succeeds
patches.manual: The probe is not exported and needs a mocked OAuth endpoint; covered by the marker check until a seam exists.

patches.summary: Drop stale OAuth callbacks and reject a callback whose state does not match the current flow.
patches.manual: Client-only localStorage/popup guard; this repo has no DOM test harness.

patches.summary: Honor explicit custom-model caps on the OpenAI-compatible /v1/models surface.
Flatten text-only turns for legacy OpenAI-compatible servers, unless cache markers must survive.
Never expose raw API keys as byApiKey object keys in usage stats.
